B0300.title: HVAC Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0300.description: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the evaporator temperature sensor circuit, used to prevent evaporator icing.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0305.title: HVAC Sun Load Sensor Circuit
B0305.description: A fault has been detected in the sun load sensor circuit used by automatic climate control to compensate for solar gain.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0310.title: Driver Seat Position Sensor Circuit
B0310.description: Driver Seat Position Sensor Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. The sensor reports seat position for the memory function and SRS occupant logic.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0312.title: Driver Seat Forward/Back Switch Circuit
B0312.description: The seat module has detected a fault in the fore/aft adjustment switch on the driver seat. Manual adjustment of the seat position may be limited or not work at all.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0320.title: Passenger Seat Position Sensor Circuit
B0320.description: Passenger Seat Position Sensor Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. The sensor reports seat position for the memory function and SRS occupant logic.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0322.title: Driver Seat Tilt Position Sensor
B0322.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat tilt position sensor. Memory positions for seat back tilt cannot be reliably stored.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0325.title: Driver Seat Memory Set Switch
B0325.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat memory set switch circuit. Seat positions cannot be saved to memory presets.

causes.label: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0327.title: Passenger Seat Position Memory
B0327.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger seat position memory function. Saved positions cannot be reliably restored.

causes.label: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0330.title: HVAC Rear Blower Motor Circuit
B0330.description: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the rear blower motor circuit, used in vehicles with rear climate zone.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0335.title: Driver Seat Heater Circuit
B0335.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat heater circuit. The heating element or wiring is open or shorted — the seat does not heat.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0337.title: Passenger Seat Heater Circuit
B0337.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger seat heater circuit. Same fault profile as B0335 but for the passenger seat.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0339.title: Rear Seat Heater Circuit
B0339.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear seat heater circuit. The rear heating elements are open or shorted.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0341.title: HVAC Heated Seat Driver Circuit
B0341.description: A fault has been detected in the driver heated seat circuit. Seat heating may be disabled.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0342.title: HVAC Heated Seat Passenger Circuit
B0342.description: A fault has been detected in the passenger heated seat circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired
